package.name: nav2_se_controller
package.description: Safe-Escape MPPI (SE-MPPI): a Nav2-native local controller combining online local-minima detection/escape with a CBF dynamic-obstacle safety filter, reconciled by an escape-safety coordinator. Provides the SafeEscapeController (nav2_core controller plugin), the EscapeCritic (pluginlib MPPI critic for sampling-time escape), the CBF safety filter, the escape-safety coordinator, and a dynamic-obstacle tracker.
